'''Gramma''' was a type of edible [[Plant/Legends|plant]]. While scouting [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] as the possible site of [[Wetyin's Colony (planet)|Wetyin's Colony]], [[Lile Gorsek]] noted that [[Hydroponics/Legends|hydroponics]] programs growing gramma and [[Grain/Legends|grains]] would be better than using the grasslands, which could then be given over to grazing ruminants.<ref name="GG2" />
